meta.name: api-designer
meta.description: Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error handling standards.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计 REST 或 GraphQL 接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计 API 架构或编写 OpenAPI 规范
copy.tagline_en: Design REST or GraphQL API specifications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design API architecture or write OpenAPI specs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会以高级API架构师的身份工作：设计REST或GraphQL API时，它帮你分析需求、建模资源、设计端点和HTTP方法，写出OpenAPI 3.1规范，并交付资源模型、错误响应目录、版本策略等设计文档。
howto.when: 当你说“设计REST或GraphQL API”、“写OpenAPI规范”或“规划API架构”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理REST API，包含分页和版本策略
say.note: 会生成资源模型和OpenAPI 3.1规范。

say.text: 把这个后端接口整理成OpenAPI 3.1规范
设计一个GraphQL接口的schema，考虑错误处理和鉴权
say.note: 会给出schema和错误响应设计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a senior API architect: when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, it analyzes domain, models resources, designs endpoints, creates an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and delivers resource model, error catalog, and versioning strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design a REST or GraphQL API, write an OpenAPI spec, or plan API architecture.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for user management with pagination and versioning.
say_en.note: Returns a resource model and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec.

say_en.text: Describe this backend API as an OpenAPI 3.1 spec.
Design a GraphQL schema with error handling and auth.
say_en.note: Provides schema and error response design.
